era: 1858 年生于法国阿尔萨斯的埃皮纳勒一个犹太拉比世家——原名额 impoverished 边境省份的中产虔信家庭，本名大卫·埃米尔；少年即崭露头角，1879 年进入巴黎高等师范学院——与让·饶勒斯同窗，师从布德与菲斯泰尔·德·库朗日；1885-1886 赴德游学（柏林、莱比锡），把冯特实验心理学与德国社会科学方法带回法国；1887 年在波尔多大学获得法国第一个社会学教席——社会学从此在法国大学体制内立足；1896 年创办《社会学年鉴》(L'Année Sociologique)——以此为中心聚合了整个学派（莫斯、于贝尔、西米昂等）；德雷福斯事件中公开站在左拉一边——学派的政治介入标志；1902 年进入索邦，1913 年讲座正式冠名'社会学'；儿子安德烈战死于一战前线（1915），他受此重创，1917 年中风去世——社会学第一位建制性立法者的谢幕
era_en: Born 1858 at Épinal in Alsace into a family of rabbis — originally named David Émile, of a pious middle-class household in an impoverished border province; precocious, entering the École Normale Supérieure in 1879 — classmate of Jean Jaurès, student of Boutroux and Fustel de Coulanges; in 1885-86 a study tour of Germany (Berlin, Leipzig) bringing Wundt's experimental psychology and German social science back to France; in 1887 the first chair of sociology in France at Bordeaux — sociology taking root in the university system; in 1896 founding L'Année Sociologique — the journal around which a whole school gathered (Mauss, Hubert, Simiand); publicly at Dreyfus's side in the Affair — the school's political engagement made flagrant; to the Sorbonne in 1902, his chair formally titled sociology in 1913; his son André killed at the front (1915), he broke under the blow and died of a stroke in 1917 — the passing of sociology's first institutional lawgiver
school: 社会学奠基 / 实证方法 / 失范与团结理论 / 宗教社会学 / 法国年鉴学派之源
historical_significance: 社会学的立法者：把孔德的哲学纲领变成大学里可操作的科学建制——第一个社会学教席、第一份学派期刊、第一套方法准则；他给这门学科立下三条宪法：社会事实是物、社会学解释必须还原到其他社会事实、普遍性是健康的判据；《自杀论》证明统计比率可以解剖道德议题，《社会分工论》给出团结的类型学，《宗教生活的基本形式》把神圣性还原为社会自我崇拜——三部曲至今是学科的地基；他的失范概念成为诊断现代性的一号术语（后经默顿结构化）；他证明'个人的事'可以被社会性地解释——认知的层级由此改写
historical_significance_en: The lawgiver of sociology: turning Comte's philosophical programme into an operative scientific establishment within the university — the first chair, the first school journal, the first set of methodological rules; three articles of constitution for the discipline: social facts are things, sociological explanation must be by other social facts, generality the test of health; Suicide proved statistical rates could dissect moral topics, the Division of Labour gave the typology of solidarity, the Elementary Forms reduced the sacred to society's worship of itself — a trilogy still the discipline's foundation; his concept of anomie the leading term for diagnosing modernity (later structured by Merton); he showed that 'the personal' can be explained socially — the hierarchy of cognition thereby rewritten
unique_thinking: 涂尔干的思维内核是'层级换轨'：解释社会现象时禁止滑入心理层——自杀率不是意志的加总而是社会的属性，宗教不是幻觉的集合而是社会的自我崇拜；第二个内核是'以普遍性定健康'：不被道德直觉牵着走，先问现象在该发展阶段是否普遍——诊断先于处方；第三个内核是'结构双轴'：整合（联结的密度）与规制（规则的松紧）两轴交叉定位一切社会病理——失范即双轴俱松；第四个内核是'功能与起源分问'：它从哪来与它为何还在是两个问题；第五个内核是'中间体思维'：国家与个人之间必须有职业共同体作为第二直接体——原子化即病理
unique_thinking_en: Durkheim's cognitive core is the change of level: in explaining social phenomena the slide into the psychological is forbidden — the suicide rate not a sum of wills but a property of society, religion not a collection of illusions but society's worship of itself; the second core is generality as the test of health: not led by moral intuition, first asking whether the phenomenon is general to the stage — diagnosis before prescription; the third is the twin axes of structure: integration (density of bonds) and regulation (tightness of rules) crossing to locate all social pathology — anomie both axes slack; the fourth, function and origin kept as separate questions: where from, and why still here; the fifth, the thought of the intermediate body: between state and individual there must be the professional community as a second immediacy — atomisation itself the pathology
civilization_zh: 第三共和国的法国：普法战败与巴黎公社的双重创伤后，'社会如何重新凝聚'是整个时代的焦虑——实证主义（孔德）、共和世俗化与天主教会拉锯、德雷福斯事件撕裂全国；法国大学体制正在扩张，一个新学科可以借体制立法出生；德国社会科学（冯特民族心理学、施穆勒历史学派）提供了方法参照；犹太拉比家庭的出身让他终生处于'内部的外人'位置——对集体凝聚的关切既有学理根源也有身份根源；一战终结了美好年代也终结了他的学派第一代
civilization_en: France of the Third Republic: after the double wound of the defeat by Prussia and the Paris Commune, 'how can society re-cohere' the anxiety of the whole age — positivism (Comte), the republican secularisation wrestling with the Catholic church, the Dreyfus Affair tearing the nation; the French university expanding, a new discipline able to be born by institutional legislation; German social science (Wundt's Völkerpsychologie, the Schmoller school) a methodological reference; born of a rabbinical family, he lived all his life as an insider-outsider — his concern for collective cohesion rooted in doctrine and in identity alike; the Great War ended the belle époque and the first generation of his school
roles_zh: 社会学家（学科建制与准则的立法者）；方法论学者（《自杀论》确立的比率分析方法）；道德哲学家（世俗道德教育的设计者）；宗教社会学家（神圣性社会起源论的奠基人）；学术组织者（《社会年鉴》学派的核心与旗帜）
roles_en: Sociologist (lawgiver of the discipline's establishment and rules); methodologist (the rate-analysis method established by Suicide); moral philosopher (designer of secular moral education); sociologist of religion (founder of the social-origin thesis of the sacred); academic organiser (core and banner of the Année Sociologique school)
key_works: 《社会分工论》(1893)——机械/有机团结类型学与失范概念的提出
《社会学方法的准则》(1895)——社会事实当作物的三条方法准则
《自杀论》(1897)——统计比率解剖道德议题的学科示范之作
《个体表象与集体表象》(1898)——层级解释原则的哲学奠基
《原始分类》(与莫斯合著, 1903)——范畴社会起源论的奠基文本
《宗教生活的基本形式》(1912)——神圣性=社会自我崇拜的总论证
key_concepts: 社会事实 fait social（对个体外在且具有强制力的集体现象——社会学的专属对象）
集体意识 conscience collective（共享规范与信仰对个体施加的超越性压力——机械团结的黏合剂）
失范 anomie（规范真空状态下欲望失去度量衡——诊断现代性的核心术语）
集体欢腾 effervescence collective（仪式聚集产生情感能量并凝结为神圣符号——神圣性的社会制造）
机械/有机团结 solidarité mécanique/organique（相似性凝聚与差异性互依的两大类型）
集体表象 représentations collectives（不能还原为个体心理的共享观念——层级解释的根据）
神圣/凡俗二分 sacré/profane（宗教生活的基本范畴——神圣物是被集体能量充值的凡物）
中间群体 corps intermédiaires（国家与个人之间的职业共同体——反原子化的第二直接体）
cross_references: M-DUR-001（社会事实观法——全部方法的总纲：当作物来考察）
M-DUR-003（机械有机团结法——类型学的双极坐标系）
M-DUR-004（失范诊断法——规范真空的诊断术）
M-DUR-008（比率社会分析法——自杀论确立的统计差分逻辑）
M-MON-008（孟德斯鸠·历史比较归纳法——比较方法的先驱脉络）
M-HRD-008（希罗多德·大尺度比较法——结构比较的古今同构）
M-HZX-005（黄宗羲·制度分析法——制度作为社会凝结物的东方对话）
M-MAI-001（迈蒙尼德·体系整合法——把杂多经验纳入统一框架的同构）

modes.domain_zh: 社会学方法论/把社会事实当作'物'来考察
modes.domain_en: Sociological methodology / social facts treated as things
modes.definition_zh: 社会学方法论/《社会学方法的准则》开篇立规：把社会事实当作'物'来考察——集体信仰、潮流、制度虽然无形，却对个体有外在强制力，须像自然科学处理物理对象一样客观观察、定义、测量；拒绝用心理学或个人动机解释社会现象——自杀率的高低不是个人意志的加总，而是社会自身的属性
modes.definition_en: Sociological methodology / the rule laid down in The Rules of Sociological Method: treat social facts as things — collective beliefs, currents and institutions, though immaterial, exert external constraint on the individual and must be observed, defined and measured objectively as natural science treats physical objects; refuse to explain the social by the psychological or the individual — the rate of suicide is not the sum of private wills but a property of society itself
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会学方法的准则》(1895)：'第一条也是最基本的原则是：把社会事实当作物来考察'——先下操作性定义再收集数据
modes.key_quote_zh: 把社会事实当作物来考察——它对个人是外在的、强制的；看不见不等于不存在，无形不等于不可测。
modes.key_quote_en: Treat social facts as things — external and constraining to the individual; invisible is not nonexistent, and immaterial is not unmeasurable.
key_concepts: 外在性 exteriority（社会事实先于个体存在并从外部塑造个体——出生时的语言、货币、道德已在那里等待）
exteriority (social facts exist before the individual and shape from without — language, money and morals already waiting at birth)
强制力 constraint（违反社会规范会被孤立、惩罚、羞辱——强制力是识别社会事实的操作性判据）
constraint (violating the norm brings isolation, penalty, shame — constraint the operational test for spotting a social fact)
物化观察 objectifying observation（先给现象下操作性定义再收集数据——防止概念飘移和循环论证）
objectifying observation (define the phenomenon operationally before gathering data — against concept-drift and circular argument)
反心理还原 anti-psychological reduction（不能用个人动机解释集体现象——层级不同，规律不同）
anti-psychological reduction (collective phenomena not explained by private motives — different level, different law)
process_zh: 锁定对象：识别一个对个体施加外部压力的集体现象——规范、潮流、仪式、舆论
下操作性定义：给现象写一个可测量、可重复的定义——排除常识用语的模糊性
取集体数据：收集跨群体、跨时间的分布数据——看的是比率与结构，不是个案
拒绝心理解释：当解释滑向'因为人们想要'时停下来——追问什么样的社会结构产生这样的比率
process_en: Spot the object: identify a collective phenomenon that presses on individuals — norm, fashion, ritual, opinion
Define operationally: write a measurable, repeatable definition of it — ousting the vagueness of common-sense words
Take collective data: gather distributions across groups and time — rates and structures, not anecdotes
Refuse the psychological: when the explanation slides to 'because people want', stop — ask what social structure produces such a rate
representative_cases_zh: 《自杀论》的开创性设计：不用'自杀者的故事'而用各国自杀率的稳定差异作研究对象——社会事实第一次被当作可测量的物
对'犯罪是病态'的常识判断的拒绝：涂尔干论证犯罪在任何社会都存在且有其功能——用普遍性检验替代道德直觉
宗教定义的操作化：《宗教生活的基本形式》先定义宗教（神圣/凡俗二分+教会）再进入田野——定义先于材料的纪律
representative_cases_en: Suicide's groundbreaking design: not the stories of the dead but the stable difference of national rates as the object — the first taking of a social fact as a measurable thing
The refusal of the common judgement 'crime is pathological': Durkheim argues crime exists in every society and has its function — universality-testing in place of moral intuition
The operational definition of religion: the Elementary Forms first defines religion (sacred/profane division plus a church) before entering the field — definition-before-material as discipline
modern_applications_zh: 平台内容治理：把'谣言传播'下定义为可测量的传播结构指标（跨群体转发率衰减）而非'用户素质'——在结构层治理
组织文化诊断：用离职率、会议发言分布等集体指标替代'员工态度'访谈归因——文化是结构不是心情
公共健康政策：把'健康行为'当作受规范强制的社会事实——设计群体规范干预而非个人说服
modern_applications_en: Content-governance on platforms: define 'rumour spread' as a measurable structural index (decay of cross-group forwarding) not 'user quality' — governing at the structural level

Organisational-culture diagnosis: collective indices — attrition rate, distribution of who speaks in meetings — in place of attributing to 'employee attitude' interviews; culture is structure, not mood
Public health: treat 'health behaviour' as a social fact under normative constraint — designing group-norm interventions rather than individual persuasion
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
孔德（先驱：'社会学'一词的铸造者与实证主义纲领——涂尔干的直接学术父辈）
默顿（后继：中层理论与功能分析的规范化——把涂尔干纲领推进到经验研究）

modes.domain_zh: 社会学方法论/正常与病态的判据是普遍性
modes.domain_en: Sociological methodology / normality judged by generality, not moral feeling
modes.definition_zh: 社会学方法论/正常与病态的判据不是道德感受而是普遍性——凡普遍存在于特定社会发展阶段的现象即属正常，犯罪、离婚、危机皆可正常；只有超出该阶段平均水平的偏离才是病态；方法论上先问'这是不是该阶段的正常形态'再谈'应不应该'——诊断先于治疗，结构先于评价
modes.definition_en: Sociological methodology / the test of normal versus pathological is not moral feeling but generality — whatever is general to a given social stage is normal, and crime, divorce and crisis may all be normal; only deviation beyond the stage's average is pathological; methodologically ask first 'is this the normal form of this stage' and only then 'should it be' — diagnosis before treatment, structure before evaluation
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会学方法的准则》第三章：犯罪是正常现象——'设想一个没有犯罪的社会是不可能的'；把普遍性作为健康判据
modes.key_quote_zh: 普遍的未必是好的，但普遍的是正常的——先判断现象属于常态还是病态，再决定要不要治、怎么治。
modes.key_quote_en: The general is not necessarily good, but the general is normal — first tell whether a phenomenon is thenormal form or the pathological, and only then whether and how to treat it.
key_concepts: 普遍性判据 the test of generality（某一阶段所有或多数社会共有的现象即正常——普遍性是健康的统计面容）
the test of generality (what all or most societies of a stage share is normal — generality the statistical face of health)
犯罪正常论 crime as normal（犯罪界定集体意识的边界并推动道德演化——消灭犯罪的社会反而是病态的）
crime as normal (crime marks the boundaries of collective conscience and drives moral evolution — the crime-free society the sick one)
功能与起源分离 function apart from origin（现象的存在理由可与其历史来源不同——问'它现在做什么'而非只问'它从哪来'）
function apart from origin (a thing's present use may differ from its historical source — ask 'what does it do now', not only 'where from')
诊断先于处方 diagnosis before prescription（道德义愤不进入诊断——先确认结构位置，再讨论干预）
diagnosis before prescription (moral indignation kept out of the diagnosis — locate the structure first, discuss intervention after)
process_zh: 写普遍性清单：该现象在不同同阶段社会中的分布——普遍/常见/罕见三档
定发展阶段：明确所属社会的结构与阶段——普遍性只在阶段内可比
判正常或病态：与阶段平均值比较——超常偏离才是病态
找功能：若正常，追问它为整体做什么——再决定干预的目标与剂量
process_en: List the distribution: how the phenomenon spreads across societies of the same stage — general, common, rare
Fix the stage: name the society's structure and stage — generality comparable only within a stage
Judge normal or pathological: against the stage's average — deviation beyond the common the only pathology
Seek the function: if normal, ask what it does for the whole — then set the aim and dose of intervention
representative_cases_zh: 犯罪正常论的经典论证：刑罚的持续存在证明犯罪内在于社会——其功能（界定规范边界、容纳道德演化）使'彻底消灭犯罪'的口号失去方法论根基
自杀率随现代化上升的诊断：把'个人道德败坏'的时代叹息改写为'社会整合度下降'的结构诊断——病态在社会层不在个人层
对经济危机的处理：危机作为正常社会的暂时病态可治——关键区分了慢性结构失衡与急性失调
representative_cases_en: The classic case for the normality of crime: the persistence of punishment proves crime internal to society — its function (marking the norm's border, housing moral evolution) deprives 'abolish crime utterly' of methodological ground
The diagnosis of the rising suicide rate: the age's sigh over 'decaying morals' rewritten as a structural diagnosis of falling integration — the pathology at society's level, not the person's
His handling of economic crises: crisis as temporary illness of a normal society, treatable — chronic structural imbalance distinguished from acute disorder
modern_applications_zh: 组织管理：把高流动率先当'行业阶段普遍现象'诊断其功能再干预——不把行业结构问题错诊为个体问题
平台治理：区分'违规内容的存在'（正常，须管理剂量）与'违规率失控'（病态，须结构手术）
公共卫生：把肥胖率、失眠率放回'所处发展阶段'的坐标系判断——先定常态基线再定政策目标
modern_applications_en: Management: diagnose high attrition first as a phenomenon general to the industry's stage and ask its function before intervening — not mistaking a structural problem for an individual one
Platform governance: separate 'the existence of violating content' (normal; manage the dose) from 'a runaway violation rate' (pathological; structural surgery)
Public health: judge obesity and insomnia rates inside the coordinate frame of the development stage — set the normal baseline before the policy target
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
默顿（后继：显功能与潜功能的区分——功能分析的完成形态）
韦伯（对照：以理解与意义取代功能诊断——两种社会认识的路线之争）

modes.domain_zh: 社会学方法论/机械与有机团结的类型学
modes.domain_en: Sociological methodology / two types of cohesion: likeness and interdependence
modes.definition_zh: 社会学方法论/社会凝聚的两种类型学：机械团结（同质个体的集体意识聚合——传统村落社会，靠相似性与压制法维系）与有机团结（分工造成的相互依赖——现代城市社会，靠差异性与恢复法维系）；社会转型的本质是从'因为相同而凝聚'到'因为不同而互需'——失范是转型期的团结真空
modes.definition_en: Sociological methodology / the typology of social cohesion: mechanical solidarity (like individuals fused by collective conscience — the traditional village, held by likeness and repressive law) and organic solidarity (mutual dependence born of the division of labour — the modern city, held by difference and restitutive law); the essence of social transition is from 'united because alike' to 'needing each other because unlike' — anomie the vacuum of cohesion in the passage
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会分工论》(1893)：分工不是经济事实而是道德事实——'分工的作用不止于创造文明，它使团结成为必要'
modes.key_quote_zh: 过去我们因为相同而团结，现在我们因为不同而互需——分工是新的道德纽带，断裂处就是失范。
modes.key_quote_en: Once we were united by likeness; now we need one another because we differ — the division of labour the new moral bond, and the rupture of it, anomie.
key_concepts: 相似性凝聚 likeness as cohesion（集体意识覆盖个体差异——共同信仰与情感是传统社会的黏合剂）
likeness as cohesion (collective conscience swamping individual difference — shared belief and feeling the glue of traditional society)
差异性互依 difference as interdependence（分工使每个人依赖所有人——功能互补取代情感同质）
difference as interdependence (the division of labour making each depend on all — functional complement replacing emotional sameness)
法型随团结走 law-type follows solidarity（压制性制裁对应机械团结，恢复性制裁对应有机团结——用法律形态读出社会类型）
law-type follows solidarity (repressive sanction for the mechanical kind, restitutive for the organic — reading society's type from its law)
转型真空 the vacuum of transition（旧的相似性团结已散、新的互依规范未立——失范是转型的影子）
the vacuum of transition (the old cohesion of likeness dissolved, the new norms of interdependence not yet built — anomie the shadow of transition)
process_zh: 判团结类型：观察群体靠什么凝聚——共同身份认同还是功能互补链
读制裁形态：看规范被违反时用的是羞辱驱逐还是补偿修复——推断社会的凝聚逻辑
找断裂带：转型组织中哪些环节还在用旧逻辑管新结构——错配点即风险点
建互依规范：为分工后的新结构设计补偿性协作规则——让'互需'制度化
process_en: Tell the type of cohesion: observe what binds the group — shared identity or a chain of functional complement
Read the sanction: when a norm breaks, is it shame and expulsion or restitution and repair — infer the logic of cohesion
Find the rupture: which parts of a transforming organisation still govern new structures with old logic — the mismatch the risk
Build the norms of interdependence: design restitutive rules of collaboration for the divided structure — institutionalising the mutual need
representative_cases_zh: 《社会分工论》的类型学建构：从法律形态反推社会团结类型——压制法占主导的社会与恢复法占主导的社会分属两极
对'为什么传统社区拆迁后邻里关系瓦解'的解释：相似性团结的物质基础被拆除而互依纽带未及建立——失范的结构根源
对职业群体（法团）的再主张：现代分工社会需要职业伦理作为新的团结中介——功能群体承载道德
representative_cases_en: 组织转型诊断：事业部化后用'职能相似'考核'产品互补'团队——机械团结的管理方式错配有机团结的结构
平台生态治理：把商户、骑手、用户视为互依分工体设计恢复性规则（保险、仲裁）而非一律惩罚
跨文化并购：判断双方分别处于机械/有机团结类型——整合方案须按各自凝聚逻辑定制
modern_applications_zh: 组织转型诊断：事业部化后用'职能相似'考核'产品互补'团队——机械团结的管理方式错配有机团结的结构
平台生态治理：把商户、骑手、用户视为互依分工体设计恢复性规则（保险、仲裁）而非一律惩罚
跨文化并购：判断双方分别处于机械/有机团结类型——整合方案须按各自凝聚逻辑定制
modern_applications_en: Organisational-transition diagnosis: after divisionalisation, managing complementary product teams by 'similarity of function' — the mechanics of likeness misapplied to an organic structure
Platform-ecosystem governance: merchants, riders and users treated as an interdependent division of labour, restitutive rules (insurance, arbitration) designed rather than uniform punishment
Cross-border M&A: judge which side is mechanical and which organic in solidarity — the integration plan tailored to each one's logic of cohesion
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
斯宾塞（对话对象：'工业社会'的进化论类型学——涂尔干以道德纽带的重新奠基超越它）
贝克尔（后继：'神圣化'与世俗社会分析——类型学传统的现代延展）

modes.domain_zh: 社会学方法论/规范真空的社会诊断
modes.domain_en: Sociological methodology / diagnosing the vacuum of norms
modes.definition_zh: 社会学方法论/失范（anomie）即规范的失能：社会急速变化时，旧规则失效而新规则未立，个体欲望失去社会给出的度量衡——'欲无止境，而能止欲者唯有社会'；失范不是个人越轨的原因学而是集体状态的诊断学：自杀率、经济危机、职业倦怠都可读作规范真空的症候——诊断社会而非谴责个人
modes.definition_en: Sociological methodology / anomie is the失效 of norms: in rapid change old rules die before new ones stand, and individual desire loses the measure society once supplied — 'desire is endless; only society can bound it'; anomie not a causal theory of personal deviance but a diagnostic of collective states: suicide rates, crises, burnout all readable as symptoms of a normative vacuum — diagnose the society, do not condemn the person
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《自杀论》(1897)第三编'利己型与失范型自杀'；《社会分工论》第二版序言：'我们的疾病并非源于无知，而是源于规范缺位'
modes.key_quote_zh: 欲望本身没有刹车，给欲望定界的是规范——规范真空处，就是失范；诊断指向社会结构，而非惩罚个体。
modes.key_quote_en: Desire has no brake of its own; it is norms that bound it — where norms are vacant, there is anomie; the diagnosis points at social structure, not at the punishment of persons.
key_concepts: 规范真空 normative vacuum（规则失效与新规则缺位的间隔期——失范是过渡状态而非道德败坏）
normative vacuum (the interval when rules have died and new ones have not formed — anomie a passage, not depravity)
欲望无界 desire unbounded（人的欲望天然无限，止欲机制来自社会——度量衡失灵则欲望病理化）
desire unbounded (human want naturally endless; the bounding mechanism social — when the measure fails, desire turns pathological)
集体症候 collective symptom（自杀率、危机、倦怠是社会层指标的读数——把个体悲剧读成结构信号）
collective symptom (rates of suicide, crisis and burnout as society-level readings — individual tragedy read as structural signal)
整合与规制双轴 the twin axes of integration and regulation（结合过弱是利己型，规则过松是失范型——两轴交叉定位病理）
the twin axes of integration and regulation (too-weak bonds the egoistic type, too-loose rules the anomic — pathology located by their crossing)
process_zh: 测整合度：目标人群的社会连接密度（家庭/职业/社群纽带）——画整合轴
测规制度：该人群面对的规则明确度与期望合理度——画规制轴
找真空带：两轴双低象限即失范高危区——对照异常指标分布验证
补规范设计：在真空带重建中间组织与规则——群体伦理优先于个体说教
process_en: Measure integration: the density of the group's social bonds — family, occupation, community; draw the integration axis
Measure regulation: the clarity of rules and the reasonableness of expectations the group faces; draw the regulation axis
Find the vacuum: the quadrant where both run low is high-risk for anomie — check it against where abnormal indicators cluster
Rebuild the norms: restore intermediate bodies and rules in the vacuum — group ethics before individual exhortation
representative_cases_zh: 《自杀论》的失范型自杀：经济危机与骤富同样推高自杀率——欲望失去既有锚点时突如其来的自由成为致命负担
对离婚率上升的解释框架：婚姻规范的约束力衰退快于新规范形成——症候在制度层不在个人德性层
职业群体道德失灵的观察：行会解体后工人与雇主都陷入'期望无度'——法团主张的政策根源
representative_cases_en: 组织变革期管理：裁员、重组后规则真空期员工越轨率上升——重建中间层规范优先于加强惩罚
平台经济治理：新业态（骑手、主播）爆发期事故率攀升是失范信号——先立行业规范再谈追责
用户增长策略：'无限激励'（积分、排行榜）会制造失范型倦怠——设计合理期望的度量衡
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革期管理：裁员、重组后规则真空期员工越轨率上升——重建中间层规范优先于加强惩罚
平台经济治理：新业态（骑手、主播）爆发期事故率攀升是失范信号——先立行业规范再谈追责
用户增长策略：'无限激励'（积分、排行榜）会制造失范型倦怠——设计合理期望的度量衡
modern_applications_en: Managing through organisational change: after layoffs and reorganisations, deviance rises in the normative vacuum — rebuilding middle-layer norms takes priority over harsher penalties
Governing the platform economy: accident rates climbing in a new trade's explosive phase are an anomic signal — set the industry's norms before assigning blame
Growth strategy: 'unbounded incentives' (points, leaderboards) breed anomic burnout — design a measure of reasonable expectation
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
默顿（后继：失范理论的结构化——目标与手段的失谐类型学）
滕尼斯（对照：共同体与社会的二分——同题不同解的德国路线）

modes.domain_zh: 社会建构方法论/国家与个人之间的第二直接体
modes.domain_en: Social-construction methodology / intermediate bodies between state and individual
modes.definition_zh: 社会建构方法论/个体与社会之间必须有中间群体：家庭、行会、职业共同体——它们既把个体从原子化孤独中救出（整合），又把抽象的社会规范翻译成具体可感的群体伦理（规制）；现代国家与个人直接面对面的结构是失范之源——第二直接体的缺失使个体既失去保护又失去约束
modes.definition_en: Social-construction methodology / between individual and society there must stand intermediate bodies: family, guild, professional community — they pull the individual out of atomised loneliness (integration) and translate abstract social norms into a felt group ethic (regulation); the modern structure of state and individual face to face is the source of anomie — lacking a second immediacy, the individual loses both protection and constraint
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会分工论》第二版序言：'法团'（corporations professionnelles）主张——职业群体应成为未来的政治基本单元
modes.key_quote_zh: 国家与个人之间必须有第二直接体——职业共同体既保护个体，又给欲望立规矩；原子化是失范的温床。
modes.key_quote_en: Between state and individual there must be a second immediacy — the professional community both shelters the person and bounds desire; atomisation is the hotbed of anomie.
key_concepts: 第二直接体 the second immediacy（个体需要可触摸的归属——抽象公民身份不足以安放忠诚）
the second immediacy (the person needs a tangible belonging — abstract citizenship cannot house loyalty)
群体伦理 group ethic（职业规范比国家法律更贴近日常——道德在'我们这行怎么做'中存活）
group ethic (professional norms nearer to daily life than statute — morality lives in 'how it is done in our trade')
反原子化 anti-atomisation（中间群体的缺失使个体直面巨大的抽象社会——脆弱且无约束）
anti-atomisation (without intermediate bodies the individual faces the vast abstract society alone — defenceless and unbound)
功能共同体 functional community（按职业与功能组织而非地域——现代性下的团结新载体）
functional community (organised by trade and function rather than territory — the new carrier of cohesion under modernity)
process_zh: 测原子化度：个体的社会连接是否只剩'国家—个人'两级——中间层厚度评估
找潜在载体：该人群已有的职业/兴趣/互助网络——存量共同体盘点
赋群体以伦理：帮共同体形成自己的规范、仪式与惩戒——从群到道德体
接通两级：让中间群体在国家制度与个体生活间双向翻译——政策落地走群体通道
process_en: Gauge the atomisation: whether the person's ties have shrunk to the two poles of state and self — assessing the thickness of the middle layer
Find the latent carriers: the trade, interest and mutual-aid networks the group already has — an inventory of existing commons
Endow the group with an ethic: help the community form its own norms, rites and sanctions — from mere group to moral body
Wire the two poles: let the intermediate body translate both ways between state institutions and individual life — policy delivered through the group channel
representative_cases_zh: 对法团的系统主张：从古罗马行会到中世纪同业公会的功能梳理——职业群体被论证为现代民主的道德基础设施
对家庭功能变化的定位：家庭不能独自承担整合功能——需要职业共同体的补位而非家庭万能论
对社会主义与个人主义两大思潮的第三条路：不靠国家吞没个体，也不靠市场原子化个体——中介组织路线
representative_cases_en: 行业自律组织设计：把'平台—骑手'两级结构改为'平台—骑手工会/互助会—骑手'——中间层承载规范与申诉
社区治理：把业委会、业主群从聊天群升级为有规范与仪式的共同体——原子化小区的失范治理
企业内团体：跨部门虚拟团队如果只靠KPI连接会散——用共享仪式与内部伦理形成第二归属
modern_applications_zh: 行业自律组织设计：把'平台—骑手'两级结构改为'平台—骑手工会/互助会—骑手'——中间层承载规范与申诉
社区治理：把业委会、业主群从聊天群升级为有规范与仪式的共同体——原子化小区的失范治理
企业内团体：跨部门虚拟团队如果只靠KPI连接会散——用共享仪式与内部伦理形成第二归属
modern_applications_en: Designing industry self-regulation: 'platform—guild/association—rider' in place of the two-level 'platform—rider' — the middle layer carrying norms and appeals
Community governance: upgrading the owners' chat group into a commons with rules and rites — governing the anomie of the atomised estate
In-firm groups: cross-functional teams bound by KPI alone scatter — shared rites and an internal ethic make the second belonging
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
托克维尔（先驱：结社自由与'中间团体'的政治理论——涂尔干把政治观察转为道德建构）
帕特南（远裔：'独自打保龄'与社会资本研究——中间群体衰退诊断的当代延续）

modes.domain_zh: 文化生成方法论/情感能量凝结为神圣符号
modes.domain_en: Cultural-generation methodology / ritual energy crystallised into the sacred
modes.definition_zh: 文化生成方法论/集体仪式的高潮时刻（节庆、游行、球赛、演唱会）产生'集体欢腾'——人群共处激发的情感能量超过个体总和，正是这种能量把群体对自己力量的感觉固化为'神圣物'；符号（图腾、旗帜、吉祥物）是欢腾的储存器与再触发器——神圣性不是超自然赐予而是社会自我崇拜的产物
modes.definition_en: Cultural-generation methodology / the climax moments of collective ritual (festival, march, match, concert) generate collective effervescence — the emotional energy of the crowd in common exceeding the sum of individuals; it is this energy that fixes the group's sense of its own force into a 'sacred thing'; symbols (totem, flag, mascot) are the reservoirs and re-triggers of the effervescence — the sacred not a supernatural gift but society's worship of itself
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《宗教生活的基本形式》(1912)第二部第七章'集体欢腾'——澳洲部落 corroboree 仪式的分析
modes.key_quote_zh: 神圣感是社会自己制造的能量——人群相聚的欢腾把集体的力量感凝成符号；符号一旦树立，就能随时把能量再点燃。
modes.key_quote_en: The sense of the sacred is energy society makes itself — the effervescence of the gathered crowd congeals the feeling of collective force into a symbol; once raised, the symbol can relight the energy at will.
key_concepts: 情感能量 emotional energy（共处人群的情愫相互感染放大——身体在场的密度是能量来源）
emotional energy (feelings of the co-present crowd infecting and amplifying one another — the density of bodies the source)
力量感投射 projection of collective force（欢腾中群体体验到超出个体的力量——这力量被归于神圣物）
projection of collective force (in the effervescence the group feels a power beyond any member — and attributes it to the sacred thing)
符号储存器 symbol as reservoir（图腾/旗帜/品牌把瞬时能量结晶为持久物——符号可存储、可运输、可再触发）
symbol as reservoir (totem, flag, brand — the moment's energy crystallised into a durable thing, storable, portable, re-triggerable)
仪式周期性 ritual periodicity（能量会耗散——定期的再聚集仪式是维持神圣性的充电路径）
ritual periodicity (the energy drains — regular re-gathering the charging path that keeps the sacred alive)
process_zh: 设计聚集：让目标群体有高密度共处的场景（活动、仪式、里程碑时刻）
制造同步：节奏、口号、统一动作——同步性放大情感感染
凝结晶符号：在欢腾峰值把共同体验锚定到具体符号上——命名、徽记、 artifact
建立周期：安排定期再聚集——用仪式给符号充电而非让符号裸奔
process_en: Stage the gathering: scenes of high-density co-presence for the target group — events, rites, milestone moments
Make it synchronous: rhythm, chant, unified gesture — synchrony amplifies the contagion of feeling
Crystallise the symbol: at the peak, anchor the shared experience to a concrete token — a name, a badge, an artefact
Set the cycle: schedule the re-gatherings — recharge the symbol by ritual rather than letting it run bare
representative_cases_zh: 澳洲 corroboree 仪式的分析：平时分散觅食的部落周期性聚集，仪式高潮中体验到'被更大的东西托住'——图腾制度的功能主义解释起源
法国大革命节庆的分析：革命政权试图用公民节庆再造神圣性——现代政治仪式研究的起点
对宗教'神圣/凡俗'二分的推导：神圣物即被群体赋予集体力量的凡物——宗教起源于社会自身的自我崇拜
representative_cases_en: The analysis of the corroboree: the scattered foraging band periodically gathering, and in the ritual's climax feeling 'held by something larger' — the functionalist origin of totemism
His analysis of the festivals of the French Revolution: a regime trying to remake the sacred by civic festival — the starting point of the study of modern political ritual
The derivation of the sacred/profane division: the sacred thing a common thing charged with collective force — religion beginning in society's worship of itself
modern_applications_zh: 品牌社群运营：发布会、会员日、统一黑话与手势——把用户情感能量结晶为品牌符号再周期性充电
团队文化建设：里程碑庆祝+定制信物+年会仪式——文化不是墙上的标语而是欢腾的存储器
社区治理：广场舞、集市、节庆活动的规划价值——公共空间的功能是制造集体欢腾抑制失范
modern_applications_en: Brand-community operations: launches, member days, shared jargon and gesture — crystallising the users' emotional energy into the brand symbol, then recharging it on a cycle
Team culture: milestone celebrations, custom tokens, the annual rite — culture not the slogan on the wall but the reservoir of effervescence
Community planning: the value of squares, markets and festivals — public space's function is to manufacture effervescence against anomie
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
莫斯（后继：'总体的社会事实'与礼物交换——欢腾理论的仪式扩展）
柯林斯（远裔：互动仪式链理论——情感能量概念的微观社会学完成）

modes.domain_zh: 认识论方法论/思维范畴的社会生成
modes.domain_en: Epistemological methodology / the categories of thought born of social life
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/人类最基本的思维范畴（时间、空间、类别、因果、神圣/凡俗）不是先验的也不是纯个人的——它们起源于社会生活的结构：历法是社会节奏的结晶，空间分类映射营地布局，逻辑类别源于社会分类（'人/非人'先于'类/种'）；思维的地基是社会性的——考察一个概念先问'什么样的社会生活需要这个概念'
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology / humanity's most basic categories of thought (time, space, class, causality, sacred/profane) are neither a priori nor purely personal — they originate in the structure of social life: the calendar a crystallisation of social rhythm, spatial classification a map of the camp, logical classes from social classes ('person/non-person' before 'species/genus'); the foundations of thought are social — before examining a concept, ask what form of social life needs it
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干与莫斯《原始分类》(1903)；《宗教生活的基本形式》第二部第二卷——时间范畴源于节庆周期、空间范畴源于营地划分的论证
modes.key_quote_zh: 时间不是钟表发明的，是历法节庆的沉淀；范畴不是头脑自生的，是社会生活教给头脑的——考察概念，先看它的社会出生地。
modes.key_quote_en: The calendar did not invent time; time is the sediment of festivals; the mind did not beget its categories — social life taught them to it; before examining a concept, look at its social birthplace.
key_concepts: 范畴的社会性 the sociality of categories（思维的最底层框架来自集体生活——个体头脑是社会结构的镜子）
the sociality of categories (thought's deepest frames from collective life — the individual mind a mirror of social structure)
节奏结晶 rhythm crystallised（历法把社会节律固化为时间范畴——'周''年'是制度不是天文学）
rhythm crystallised (the calendar fixing social rhythm into the category of time — 'week' and 'year' institutions, not astronomy)
分类映射社会 classification mirrors society（逻辑层级常复制社会等级——centre/periphery、纯洁/污秽的分布有社会根源）
classification mirrors society (logical hierarchies often copying social rank — centre/periphery, pure/impure distributed along social lines)
概念考古 concept archaeology（对任何'理所当然'的范畴追问其社会生成条件——认识论问题转为社会学问题）
concept archaeology (for any 'of course' category, ask the social conditions of its making — the epistemological question turned sociological)
process_zh: 选靶概念：挑一个被当作'自然'的范畴（如'周''部门''优先级'）
找社会对应物：该范畴对应哪种集体节奏或结构——逐项映射
追变异：不同社会/组织对同一范畴的不同切法——切法差异暴露社会根源
重估范畴：判断该范畴在当前社会结构下是否仍成立——范畴可随结构更新
process_en: Pick the target: a category taken as 'natural' — the week, the department, the priority
Find its social counterpart: which collective rhythm or structure the category maps — item by item
Trace the variance: how different societies or organisations cut the same category — the differences expose the social roots
Re-assess the category: whether it still holds under the present structure — categories can be updated as structure changes
representative_cases_zh: 《原始分类》的证据链：澳洲部落按氏族划分万物（雨、星、动物各有归属）——分类体系与社会组织同构
时间范畴的论证：宗教历法把社会节庆周期当作时间本身的骨架——'一周七日'是制度结晶而非天文事实
对康德先验范畴的社会学改写：范畴仍然'先于个体经验'，但来源是集体经验而非纯粹理性——哲学问题的社会学重定位
representative_cases_en: The evidence chain of Primitive Classification: Australian clans sorting the whole world by moiety — rain, stars and beasts each with a totemic home, the scheme of classification isomorphic with social organisation
The argument on time: the religious calendar making the cycle of festivals the very skeleton of time — the seven-day week institutional sediment, not astronomical fact

The sociological rewrite of Kant's a priori: the categories still prior to individual experience, but from collective experience rather than pure reason — a philosophical question relocated into sociology
modern_applications_zh: 组织术语审计：'部门''职级''KPI'被当作自然存在——追问它们固化了哪种旧协作结构，是否还匹配当下
产品信息架构：分类体系映射团队结构而非用户心智——用范畴社会起源法诊断导航失灵
教育课程设计：'学科'边界是十九世纪知识社会的结晶——跨学科课程设计先解构学科范畴
modern_applications_en: An audit of organisational terms: 'department', 'grade', 'KPI' taken as natural — ask what older collaboration structure they congealed, and whether it still fits
Product information architecture: the taxonomy mapping the team's structure rather than the user's mind — diagnosing failed navigation by the social origin of categories
Curriculum design: the borders of 'disciplines' a crystallisation of the nineteenth-century knowledge society — interdisciplinary design begins by deconstructing the category
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
莫斯（合作者与后继：人类学分类研究的技术化）
列维-斯特劳斯（远裔：结构与分类人类学——把社会起源论推向心智普遍结构）

modes.domain_zh: 实证方法论/以群体比率作分析单位
modes.domain_en: Empirical methodology / group rates as the unit of social analysis
modes.definition_zh: 实证方法论/把社会现象的操作单位从个体事件转为群体比率：自杀研究的对象不是'谁为什么自杀'而是'不同群体自杀率的稳定差异'——性别、年龄、婚况、教派、经济周期上的规律性恰恰证明其为社会事实；比较逻辑替代个案逻辑：差异即变量，变量即结构——统计比率成为社会结构X光片
modes.definition_en: Empirical methodology / the unit of social phenomena shifted from individual events to group rates: the object of suicide research not 'who killed himself and why' but the stable differences of suicide rates across groups — regularity by sex, age, marital state, confession and the economic cycle proving the thing social; comparison in place of the case: difference is variable, variable is structure — the statistical rate as the X-ray of social structure
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《自杀论》(1897)：欧洲各省自杀率几十年稳定的差异表——'每个社会都有一笔确定的自杀配额'
modes.key_quote_zh: 个案是故事，比率是结构——同一现象在不同群体的稳定差异，就是社会变量；统计表是社会结构的X光片。
modes.key_quote_en: The case is a story, the rate a structure — the stable difference of the same phenomenon across groups is the social variable; the statistical table the X-ray of society.
key_concepts: 比率单位 the rate as unit（不是'为什么这个人'而是'为什么这个群体更高'——分析层级上移）
the rate as unit (not 'why this person' but 'why this group runs higher' — the level of analysis lifted)
稳定性即事实 stability as fact（比率跨年稳定说明有结构在支撑——波动是个案的，稳定是社会的）
stability as fact (rates steady across years show a structure underneath — fluctuation belongs to cases, stability to society)
比较差分 comparative differencing（用群体间差异反推结构变量——控制比较定位变量）
comparative differencing (inferring structural variables from inter-group differences — controlling the comparison to locate the variable)
配额论 the quota thesis（'每个社会有其自杀配额'——把道德恐慌议题转译为可测结构参数）
the quota thesis ('each society has its definite quota of suicide' — moral-panic topics translated into measurable structural parameters)
process_zh: 定义率：事件数/暴露群体数，分母口径严格统一——率是方法论的起点
切群体：按候选结构变量分组（性别/年限/规模/类型）——分组即假设
查稳定性：率的时间序列是否稳定——稳定才指向结构，漂移指向事件
差分定位：找差异最大且跨年稳定的组间对比——该组差异背后的结构变量即主嫌疑
process_en: Define the rate: events over exposed population, denominators strictly uniform — the rate the methodological start
Cut the groups: stratify by candidate structural variables — sex, tenure, size, type; each cut a hypothesis
Test stability: is the rate's time-series steady — steadiness points to structure, drift to events
Localise by difference: the widest, year-stable contrasts between groups — the structural variable behind that contrast the prime suspect
representative_cases_zh: 《自杀论》的核心数据设计：排除精神病、种族、气候等候选解释后，'已婚有子女者自杀率低于未婚'等规律性差分指向整合度变量
对'军队自杀率更高'的分析： Using 军种、服役年限分层比较——把'军人气质'的民间解释替换为规制过强的结构解释
教派差分：新教地区自杀率高于天主教地区——把神学差异读作'自由审查'（个体独自面对文本）的结构差分
representative_cases_en: The core data design of Suicide: after ruling out insanity, race and climate, regular contrasts — the married with children below the unmarried — pointing to the variable of integration
The analysis of the higher rate in armies: stratified comparison by arm and years of service — the folk explanation of 'military temperament' replaced by a structural one of over-regulation
The confessional difference: Protestant regions above Catholic — theological difference read as the structural one of 'free inquiry', the individual facing the text alone
modern_applications_zh: 产品指标分析：不问'这个用户为什么流失'而问'哪一 cohort 流失率结构性偏高'——cohort 差分定位产品变量
组织健康诊断：把离职率、病假率按部门/司龄分层——稳定差异指向管理结构而非个体经理
公共政策评估：政策效果看目标群体比率变化与未干预组的差分——个案证言不算证据
modern_applications_en: Product analytics: not 'why did this user churn' but 'which cohort churns structurally higher' — cohort differencing to locate the product variable
Organisational health: attrition and sick-leave stratified by department and tenure — stable differences indicting the management structure, not the individual manager
Policy evaluation: effects read as rate changes in the target group against the untreated — testimony no evidence
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
凯特勒（先驱：'平均人'与道德统计——比率思维的直接来源）
默顿与拉扎斯菲尔德（后继：社会研究方法论化——把涂尔干的比较逻辑规范成教科书）

modes.domain_zh: 实证方法论/功能与起源分问
modes.domain_en: Empirical methodology / explaining existence by function, apart from origin
modes.definition_zh: 实证方法论/解释一个社会现象的存在，问它对整体发挥什么功能而非它如何产生——惩罚的存在是为了维护集体意识的边界，宗教的存在在于凝聚共同体；起源与功能是两个问题：一个现象可以起源于A而功能于B；功能解释补足因果链的'当下维持'环节——但须警惕把'有用'误当'被需要'的功能主义谬误
modes.definition_en: Empirical methodology / to explain a social phenomenon's existence, ask what function it serves for the whole rather than how it arose — punishment exists to maintain the boundary of collective conscience, religion to weld the community; origin and function are two questions: a thing may have arisen from A and serve B; functional explanation completes the causal chain's 'present maintenance' link — while guarding against the functionalist fallacy of mistaking 'useful' for 'needed'
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会分工论》：犯罪的功能论证；默顿后来规范化的显/潜功能区分所本
modes.key_quote_zh: 起源回答'它从哪来'，功能回答'它为何还在'——两个问题分开问，才不会被'有用即合理'滑过去。
modes.key_quote_en: Origin answers 'where from', function answers 'why still here' — two questions kept apart, or 'useful' will slip into 'rightful'.
key_concepts: 维持环节 the maintenance link（因果链不只生成还有维持——功能解释补足'为什么它没有消失'）
the maintenance link (causation has not only generation but maintenance — functional explanation fills in 'why it has not vanished')
显功能与潜功能 manifest and latent functions（当事人承认的功能与系统实际获得的功能分开登记——雨伞的挡雨与社交）
manifest and latent functions (the function actors own apart from the function the system actually gets — the umbrella keeps off rain and makes friends)
正负功能功能替代物 function and its alternatives（同一功能可由不同制度承担——可替代性检验防止宿命论）
function and alternatives (one function served by different institutions — the substitution test against fatalism)
功能主义谬误警示 the fallacy guard（'对社会有用'不推出'被社会需要'更不推出'应当存在'——功能是解释不是辩护）
the fallacy guard ('useful to society' entails neither 'needed by society' nor 'ought to exist' — function explains, it does not justify)
process_zh: 登记现象：如实描述该现象的存续与规模——不先做价值判断
问维持：若无此现象，整体会失去什么——功能假设成型
分显潜：当事人说的功能与实际观察到的功能分别列明——潜功能常在别处
找替代物：是否存在承担同功能的其他制度——有替代则该现象非必需，干预空间出现
process_en: Record the phenomenon: its persistence and scale described as they are — no prior value judgement
Ask the maintenance: if the thing vanished, what would the whole lose — the functional hypothesis takes shape
Sort manifest from latent: the functions claimed by actors and those observed listed separately — the latent often elsewhere
Seek the substitute: is there another institution serving the same function — if so the thing is not necessary, and room for intervention opens
representative_cases_zh: 犯罪功能的经典论证：刑罚仪式强化集体意识、犯罪划出规范边界——' Crime is normal'不等于' crime is good'的功能/价值两分示范
宗教功能论：宗教的 supernatural 信仰是表层，其凝聚与规训功能是里层——解释了宗教为何在'祛魅'时代存续
婚姻与家庭的功能分析：性规制之外的情感支持、经济合作、再生产功能分层——为理解家庭形态变迁提供功能坐标
representative_cases_en: The classic argument on the function of crime: penal ritual strengthening collective conscience, crime marking the norm's border — 'crime is normal' is not 'crime is good', the model of the function/value split
The functional account of religion: supernatural belief the surface, cohesion and discipline the depth — explaining why religion persists in the age of disenchantment
The functional analysis of marriage and family: beyond sexual regulation, strata of emotional support, economic cooperation, reproduction — a functional frame for reading changes in family form
modern_applications_zh: 组织'香烟圈'分析：楼道吸烟社交是潜功能——禁烟政策须配替代性社交场景否则规制失效
流程冗余审计：某审批环节'没人说得清为什么存在'——先找它的潜功能（背锅/缓冲/寻租）再谈砍掉
政策设计：禁止一项行为前先确认其功能有替代物——否则只是把功能赶进地下
modern_applications_en: The smoking-circle analysis: corridor smoking's latent function is sociability — a ban without a substitute social scene fails by design
Process-redundancy audit: an approval step 'nobody can say why it exists' — find its latent function (scapegoating, buffering, rent) before cutting it
Policy design: before banning a practice, confirm another institution carries its function — or it merely goes underground
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
默顿（后继：显/潜功能与中层理论——功能分析的规范化者）
马林诺夫斯基（同代：人类学功能主义——需求层次的功能解释路线）

modes.domain_zh: 分析框架方法论/纯型作为现实坐标系
modes.domain_en: Analytical-framework methodology / pure types as coordinate frames for reality
modes.definition_zh: 分析框架方法论/从杂多的社会现实中提炼概念纯型：'机械团结''有机团结''集体意识'都不是对任何具体社会的照相式描摹，而是突出某一面而舍弃其余的分析构造——纯型在现实中从不纯粹存在，却让混乱的经验材料变得可比较、可定位；抽象不是失真而是给经验世界装上坐标系
modes.definition_en: Analytical-framework methodology / refining concept-pure types from the multiplicity of social reality: 'mechanical solidarity', 'organic solidarity', 'collective conscience' are not photographic portraits of any actual society but analytic constructions highlighting one face and discarding the rest — the pure type never exists pure in reality, yet makes the tangle of empirical material comparable and locatable; abstraction is not distortion but fitting the empirical world with a coordinate frame
modes.source_chapter: 涂尔干《社会分工论》《宗教生活的基本形式》的类型学建构方式：以形态学标准（法律、仪式、组织形态）构造纯型再拿经验案例定位
modes.key_quote_zh: 纯型在现实中从不纯粹——它不是照片而是坐标系；有了它，任何一个混乱的个案都能说出自己站在哪里。
modes.key_quote_en: The pure type is never found pure in reality — not a photograph but a coordinate frame; with it, any tangled case can say where it stands.
key_concepts: 单面强化 one-face emphasis（构造纯型时突出一个维度、悬置其余——抽象的取舍是方法而非疏漏）
one-face emphasis (in building the type, one dimension highlighted, the rest bracketed — abstraction's selection is method, not oversight)
反例免疫 immunity to counter-example（纯型不因'现实中没有纯机械社会'而失效——它是量尺不是标本）
immunity to counter-example (the type not refuted by 'no pure mechanical society exists' — it is a gauge, not a specimen)
定位工具 the locating tool（经验个案在两纯型之间定位（60/40）——类型学给出的是光谱不是抽屉）
the locating tool (empirical cases placed between the types — 60/40; the typology offers a spectrum, not drawers)
构造可讨论 constructibility debated（纯型的维度选择本身可被批评与替换——坐标系是共识产物不是天启）
constructibility debated (the choice of dimensions itself criticisable and replaceable — the coordinate frame a product of agreement, not revelation)
process_zh: 选维度：为问题挑一个最有解释力的轴（团结方式/规范密度/权威类型）
造两极：写出该轴的两个纯粹极限形态——每个纯型内部逻辑自洽
定位现实：把真实案例投影到两极之间给出比例——禁止非此即彼
检验解释力：换案例重复定位，看坐标系是否稳定产生洞察——不灵则换维度重造
process_en: Choose the axis: the dimension with the most explanatory power for the question — mode of cohesion, density of norms, type of authority
Build the poles: write the two pure limiting forms, each internally consistent
Locate the real: project actual cases between the poles with a ratio — no either/or allowed
Test the frame: repeat the locating on fresh cases — if the frame keeps yielding insight it holds, else rebuild the axis
representative_cases_zh: 机械/有机团结的类型学：没有任何现实社会是纯机械或纯有机——类型却使'此时此地靠什么凝聚'第一次变得可问答
集体意识的概念构造：不是描述某种共同信仰的具体内容，而是抽象出'共享规范对个体的超越性压力'这一维度
神圣/凡俗二分：从澳洲到印度教的仪式材料中提取的最简明析框架——宗教多样性下的共同坐标系
representative_cases_en: The typology of mechanical and organic solidarity: no actual society purely either — yet the type makes 'what binds here and now' answerable for the first time
The construction of collective conscience: not a description of any creed's content but the abstraction of the dimension 'the transcendent pressure of shared norms on the individual'
The sacred/profane division: the minimal frame extracted from ritual materials from Australia to Hinduism — one coordinate system under religious diversity
modern_applications_zh: 组织文化定位：用'机械—有机'轴给各部门定位（合规部靠规则聚合，创意部靠互补聚合）——管理方式按位置定制
用户分群设计：放弃非此即彼的标签（重度/轻度），在'习惯—尝鲜'轴上给出比例定位
技术选型框架：'自建—采购'两极间按控制力/速度权重定位——纯型让争论变成坐标讨论
modern_applications_en: Locating organisational culture: teams placed on the mechanical-organic axis (compliance bound by rules, creative by complement) — management style tailored to position
User segmentation: dropping either/or labels (heavy/light) for proportional placement on the habit-novelty axis
A build-vs-buy framework: locating by the weights of control and speed between the two poles — the pure type turning argument into coordinate talk
representative_figures: 涂尔干（核心）
韦伯（同代与对照：理想类型的系统化者——把方法论自觉推到顶点）
帕森斯（后继：模式变量与 AGIL——类型学传统的宏大综合）
